subject: tu:game/game/player
value: Fifteen pad_XXX[N] runs in include/game/player.h's Player were mis-classified padding and hold 25 real fields, each evidenced by in-code usage rather than by any PDB record. Recovered (offset, type, evidence class): 0x078 s32 field_078 (teardown zero-block, cleared beside p->node); 0x098 f32 combo_time (read at the motion phase exit); 0x0C4 f32 angles[3] (passed as the second CreateYPRMatrix argument, angles[1] stores `heading` beside p->move_yaw); 0x1F2 s16 field_1F2 (cleared on forced state 4 and at both DoExit resets); 0x6D8 s32 field_6D8 + 0x6DC void* grab_node (grab_node is the carry parent handed to PlayerSetGrabbed, stored from the model node in load_player_geo and zeroed beside it); 0x870 f32 vel[3] + 0x87C f32 prev_pos[3] + 0x888 f32 dpos[3] (the motion integration triad: vel*gClockFrameStep -> dpos, prev_pos saved immediately before the live position is advanced by dpos, all nine zeroed in the teardown block); 0x898 f32 field_898 (reaction deadline on the sMusicFadeBase time base, set to base+1.0 for hit flag 0x800 and base+4.0 for 0x1000, tested `base < field` to force reaction 100); 0x8B8 f32 field_8B8 (floor_base snapshot) + 0x8BC f32 field_8BC (floor slope term); 0x8D0 f32 hit_damage and 0x8DC f32 hit_force[3] (the queued-hit pair: both accumulated by damage_player -- hit_damage via `+= dmg`, hit_force from the `dir` argument -- then consumed as the knockback impulse and cleared together at the end of PlayerKnockback); 0x8F4/0x8F8 s32 field_8F4/field_8F8 (8F8 is the zero-gate on the melee branch); 0x908 s32 field_908 (selects the moving-hit anim 32); 0x93C/0x940 s32 + 0x944 f32 transport_pos[3] (transporter destination, copied from the transporter object's position then floor-collided by DoTransporter); 0x956 s16 field_956 (magic/throw request bitmask: reset 0x10, OR 2, tested 2, set 128 after start_magic); 0xA48/0xA4C/0xA50/0xA54 four f32 motion tuning scales, all reset to 10000.0f as four separate stores. Byte accounting is exact for every split (lead_pad + fields + trail_pad == the original pad; sizeof(Player) stays 0x335C and no pre-existing field offset moves), and the header edit ALONE gated GATE OK on game/game/player, game/game/pmotion and game/enemy/critter before any site was touched, per claim.law.embedded-struct-member-whole-tu-cascade's isolation requirement -- all 25 additions are scalars or arrays-of-scalars, so the aggregate-member cascade class does not apply.
